title: Quantifying Data Contamination in Psychometric Evaluations of LLMs

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3 and Appendix B.1 (temperature 0.7, three repetitions; OpenRouter API); max_tokens/top_p assumed

task.subset_rule: all items of the four inventories in the repo: BFI-44 (44), MFQ (30 after excluding the 2 'bogus' attention checks), PVQ-40 (40), SD-3 (24 in the release)
task.approximation: The released sd3.json has 24 items (psychopathy 6) versus 27 in the paper; the {dimensions} list format is not printed (comma-separated labels from the JSON meta_data); runner macro-F1 is pooled over all 23 dimension labels (the paper averages per-inventory macro-F1 over the four inventories); the runner's label match is a word-bounded substring match rather than the repository's exact string equality

items.source: inline rows copied 2026-09-07 from github.com/holi-lab/psychometric-contamination, files data/bfi44.json, data/mfq.json, data/pvq40.json, data/sd3.json (item text + meta_data.dimension; counts verified); inventory display names and the alphabetically sorted ', '-joined dimension list follow method_tasks/evaluation_memorization/main.py (INVENTORY_NAME_MAPPING, dimensions_str)
